objective.statement: Place an application version label in the footer.

complexity.rationale: One presentational element in the existing footer component plus a one-line version module; no new state, dependency or contract.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The footer shows an application version label.
The label text is the version from package.json prefixed with "v" (currently "v0.14.0").
The label is visible at all screen sizes and sits inside the existing footer landmark next to the Last updated text.

in.statement: src/components/last-updated-footer: render the version label inside the existing footer.
A small src/lib/appVersion.ts module exporting the version read from package.json.

out.statement: New dependencies, vite/vitest/tsconfig changes, build-time define injection, git SHA or build number in the label, release tooling, and any change to the Last updated text.

observations.statement: "Application version" means the package.json version field (0.14.0), imported as a named JSON export; Vite tree-shakes the rest and tsc bundler resolution allows it without config changes.
Label format is "v<version>" and it lives in the existing footer (LastUpdatedFooter) rather than a new footer component, as a sibling element in the same footer landmark.
The footer is LastUpdatedFooter, mounted in src/App.tsx; its tests are co-located and use data-id test ids from LastUpdatedFooter.testIds.ts.

provenance.source: Card: New Feature - Add a version label to the footer. Place an application version label to the footer.
Card does not say where the version comes from; conservative choice is the package.json version, with no new dependency or build config.
Card does not specify placement or format; conservative choice is the existing footer, text "v<version>", always visible.

unit.rationale: src/lib/appVersion.ts is a new module; assert it exports a semver-shaped string.

component.rationale: Rendered behaviour: the footer shows the v-prefixed version inside the footer landmark.

integration.rationale: No cross-module behaviour beyond the footer; the full npm test suite is still run as regression verification.

e2e.rationale: Static text in an already component-tested footer; no new routed flow.

increments.behavior: The footer shows "v<package.json version>" in a version label, sourced from a new appVersion module.
increments.doneWhen: Unit and component tests for the version pass, the full suite is green, and tsc and eslint are clean.
